features:
Key Features:

High Protein Content: Each bar provides 10g of protein, helping with muscle repair and keeping you full longer.

Rich in Fiber: Contains about 5g of fiber per bar, supporting healthy digestion and promoting satiety.

Made with Real Ingredients: Includes whole grain oats, roasted peanuts, creamy peanut butter, and dark chocolate chips.

Gluten-Free: Suitable for gluten-sensitive individuals without sacrificing taste.

No Artificial Additives: Free from artificial flavors, colors, and high-fructose corn syrup.

On-the-Go Friendly: Individually wrapped for convenience—great for work, school, or travel.

Benefits:

Satisfies Hunger: The combination of protein and fiber helps curb cravings and supports energy between meals.

Tasty and Nutritious: Offers a satisfying blend of sweet and salty flavors with a chewy texture.

Supports Active Lifestyles: Perfect as a post-workout snack or a quick energy boost during busy days.

Diet-Friendly Choice: Accommodates various dietary needs while delivering essential nutrients.

Wholesome Snacking: Encourages better snack choices compared to sugary or overly processed options.
ingredients: Whole Grain Oats, Sugar, Soy Protein Isolate, Semisweet Chocolate Chunks (sugar, chocolate liquor, cocoa butter, natural flavor, soy lecithin), Canola and/or Sunflower Oil, Tapioca Syrup, Molasses, Rice Starch, Cocoa Processed with Alkali, Soy Lecithin, Salt, Baking Soda, Natural Flavor. Vitamin E (mixed tocopherols) Added to Preserve Freshness.
